screening_reason: Checkpoint 2 was ceiling-saturated under no-transfer, standard one-hop MoA, and cumulative verified-history stress. Checkpoint 3 adds structure-aware pattern matching and metavariable consistency while retaining the same realistic code-search workflow.

selection_rule.preferred: Exactly one of two workers passes all checkpoint-3 Core tests, with no infrastructure or benchmark-access violation.
selection_rule.acceptable: Neither worker is full-Core, but both retain at least 0.50 normalized Core and differ meaningfully, in which case calibrate only the action budget.
selection_rule.next_step: Run the full three-arm layered contrast only after documenting the screen outcome and freezing the curve config.
